+module

+
+public import CslibFrontier.Computability.Complexity.FineGrained.LocalMapCounting

+public import CslibFrontier.Computability.Complexity.Problems.SetSplitting
+public import CslibFrontier.Logics.Propositional.CSP.ToOneHotCNF
+import CslibFrontier.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.BigO.Preprocess
+import CslibFrontier.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.Finite
+import CslibFrontier.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.List
+import CslibFrontier.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.Nat
+import CslibFrontier.Computability.Machines.Turing.MultiTape.Complexity.PolyTime.Nat.Binary
+import CslibFrontier.Computability.PolyTime.CNF.DeclaredInput
+
+/-!
+# Runtime transfers and polynomial-time bounded-width CNF counting compilations
+
+This module connects the six bounded-width CNF counting encodings to polynomial-time machine
+certificates and conditional exponential/subexponential runtime transfers:
+
+1. **General conditional runtime transfer** (`CountingTransfer.transfer_declaredCounter`,
+   `CountingTransfer.declaredCounter_of_modelCounter`): any declared `k`-CNF counter (or plain
+   `(max k 2)`-CNF model counter via tautology variable padding `CNF.padDeclaredVars`) running in
+   time `2 ^ E N * poly(|x|)` and polynomial space transfers along any polynomial-time compilation
+   `g : α → ℕ × CNF ℕ` satisfying `(g x).1 ≤ C * μ x + D` under a polynomial-time guard.
+2. **Polynomial-time bounded one-hot CSP compilation**
+   (`CSP.computableInPolyTime_toOneHotDeclaredCNF_of_forall`,
+   `CSP.computableInPolyTime_toOneHotDeclaredCNF_of_finite`): compiles a finite-domain CSP over
+   `Fin q` of arity `≤ k` on `N` declared variables into an equivalent CNF formula on `q * N`
+   variables of clause width `≤ max q (max k 2)` (`Cslib.Logic.PL.CSP.toOneHotDeclaredCNF`).
+3. **Explicit assignment bijection for constant-locality Boolean maps**
+   (`LocalMap.preimageDeclaredEquiv`): pairs `LocalMap.toDeclaredCNF` with an explicit bijection
+   between declared-range satisfying assignments and `n`-bit preimages.
+4. **Six conditional counting runtime transfers**:
+   independent sets (`width = 2`, parameter `|V|`), proper `q`-colourings (`width = max q 2`,
+   parameter `|V|`), general-graph perfect matchings (`width = 3`, parameter `|V| + |E|`),
+   fixed-arity finite-domain `#CSP` via one-hot encoding (`width = max q (max k 2)`, parameter `N`),
+   `#k-SetSplitting` (`width = k`, parameter `|U|`), and constant-locality Boolean map preimage
+   counting (`width = k`, parameter `numVars`).
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Complexity.encDeclaredCNF`, `Cslib.Complexity.encDeclaredCSP`: framed encodings of
+  declared-variable CNF and CSP instances.
+* `Cslib.Logic.PL.CNF.padDeclaredVars`: width-`2` tautology padding fixing `numVars = N`.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.LocalMap.preimageDeclaredEquiv`: explicit preimage bijection for
+  `LocalMap.toDeclaredCNF`.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.transfer_declaredCounter`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.declaredCounter_of_modelCounter`: general conditional
+  counting runtime and polynomial-space transfers.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.CSP.computableInPolyTime_toOneHotDeclaredCNF_of_forall`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.CSP.computableInPolyTime_toOneHotDeclaredCNF_of_finite`: polynomial-time
+  one-hot CSP compilation.
+* `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.exists_indepSetCounter_of_declaredCounter`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.exists_coloringCounter_of_declaredCounter`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.exists_perfectMatchingCounter_of_declaredCounter`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.exists_oneHotCSPCounter_of_declaredCounter`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.exists_setSplittingCounter_of_declaredCounter`,
+  `Cslib.Complexity.CountingTransfer.exists_localMapPreimageCounter_of_declaredCounter`:
+  conditional runtime transfers for all six counting encodings.
+
+## References
+
+* [M. Cygan et al., *Parameterized Algorithms*][CyganEtAl2015]
+* [G. S. Tseitin, *On the complexity of derivation in propositional calculus*][Tseitin1983]
+* [L. G. Valiant, *The complexity of computing the permanent*][Valiant1979]
+-/
+
+public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Logic.PL
+
+/-! ### Tautology variable padding for declared-variable CNF formulas -/
+
+namespace CNF
+
+/-- Prepend width-`2` tautology clauses `(v ∨ ¬v)` for all `v < N` so that every declared variable
+occurs explicitly without changing truth values on any assignment. -/
+@[expose] def padDeclaredVars (N : ℕ) (φ : CNF ℕ) : CNF ℕ :=
+  ((List.range N).map fun v => [(v, true), (v, false)]) ++ φ
+
+@[simp]
+theorem eval_padDeclaredVars (N : ℕ) (φ : CNF ℕ) (σ : ℕ → Bool) :
+    (padDeclaredVars N φ).eval σ = φ.eval σ := by
+  rw [padDeclaredVars, CNF.eval_append]
+  have htaut : CNF.eval σ ((List.range N).map fun v => [(v, true), (v, false)]) = true := by
+    rw [CNF.eval, List.all_eq_true]
+    intro c hc
+    obtain ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hc
+    rw [Clause.eval]
+    cases σ v <;> simp [Literal.eval]
+  rw [htaut, Bool.true_and]
+
+theorem length_clause_padDeclaredVars_le {k N : ℕ} {φ : CNF ℕ}
+    (hφ : ∀ cl ∈ φ, cl.length ≤ k) {cl : Clause ℕ} (hcl : cl ∈ padDeclaredVars N φ) :
+    cl.length ≤ max k 2 := by
+  rw [padDeclaredVars, List.mem_append] at hcl
+  rcases hcl with hcl | hcl
+  · obtain ⟨_, _, rfl⟩ := List.mem_map.mp hcl
+    exact le_max_right k 2
+  · exact (hφ cl hcl).trans (le_max_left k 2)
+
+theorem vars_padDeclaredVars_toFinset {N : ℕ} {φ : CNF ℕ}
+    (hsub : φ.vars.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range N) :
+    (padDeclaredVars N φ).vars.toFinset = Finset.range N := by
+  ext v
+  simp only [padDeclaredVars, CNF.vars, List.flatten_append, List.map_append, List.mem_toFinset,
+    List.mem_append, Finset.mem_range]
+  constructor
+  · rintro (hv | hv)
+    · simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_flatten] at hv
+      obtain ⟨l, ⟨c, hc, hl⟩, rfl⟩ := hv
+      obtain ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩ := hc
+      simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl
+      rcases hl with rfl | rfl <;> exact List.mem_range.mp hu
+    · exact Finset.mem_range.mp (hsub (List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv))
+  · intro hv
+    left
+    simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_flatten]
+    exact ⟨(v, true), ⟨[(v, true), (v, false)],
+      ⟨v, List.mem_range.mpr hv, rfl⟩,
+      List.mem_cons_self⟩, rfl⟩
+
+theorem numVars_padDeclaredVars {N : ℕ} {φ : CNF ℕ}
+    (hsub : φ.vars.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range N) :
+    (padDeclaredVars N φ).numVars = N := by
+  rw [CNF.numVars, vars_padDeclaredVars_toFinset hsub, Finset.card_range]
+
+theorem modelCount_padDeclaredVars {N : ℕ} {φ : CNF ℕ}
+    (hsub : φ.vars.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range N) :
+    (padDeclaredVars N φ).modelCount = φ.modelCountOn (Finset.range N) := by
+  rw [← CNF.modelCountOn_vars, vars_padDeclaredVars_toFinset hsub]
+  simp only [CNF.modelCountOn, eval_padDeclaredVars]
+
+end CNF
+
+end Cslib.Logic.PL
+
+namespace Cslib.Complexity
+
+open Cslib.Logic.PL Turing.MultiTapeTM SubexponentialSAT
+
+/-- Framed encoding of a declared-variable CNF instance `(N, φ) : ℕ × CNF ℕ`, with `N` in unary
+and `φ` in binary `encCNF`. -/
+abbrev encDeclaredCNF : ℕ × CNF ℕ ↪ List Bool :=

+/-
+Copyright (c) 2026 Samuel Schlesinger. All rights reserved.
+Released under Apache 2.0 license as described in the file LICENSE.
+Authors: Samuel Schlesinger

+
+module
+-- upstream: candidate
+
+public import CslibFrontier.Computability.Circuit.Boolean.Tseitin
+public import CslibFrontier.Logics.Propositional.CNF.ModelCount.Declared
+import Mathlib.Data.List.GetD
+
+/-!
+# Sequential exact-one De Morgan circuits and width-3 Tseitin compilation
+
+For a list of input wires `ws`, `seqExactlyOneClause n base ws` builds a De Morgan gate list of
+only `3 * ws.length + 3` gates (`O(ws.length)` gates rather than quadratic pairwise clauses) whose
+output wire evaluates to `true` exactly when precisely one wire in `ws` is `true`. Repeating across
+a family `wss` of wire lists (`seqExactlyOneAll n wss`) yields a gate list of
+`1 + 4 * wss.length + 3 * (wss.map List.length).sum` gates, and `tseitinSatCNF [] n gates out`
+compiles it to a width-`3` CNF formula preserving the exact number of satisfying input bitstrings
+in `O(n + ∑ |ws|)` variables.
+
+## Main definitions
+
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.tseitinSatAssignmentEquiv`: explicit bijection between satisfying input
+  bitstrings and `tseitinSatCNF` models on `Finset.range (n + gates.length)`.
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.seqExactlyOneClause`: `O(d)`-gate sequential exact-one De Morgan gadget.
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.seqExactlyOneAll`: `O(|wss| + ∑ |ws|)`-gate conjunction of exact-one
+  constraints.
+
+## Main results
+
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.vars_tseitinSatCNF_subset`: occurring-variable bound for `tseitinSatCNF`.
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.isCodeFrom_seqExactlyOneClause`,
+  `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.isCodeFrom_seqExactlyOneAll`: well-formedness (`IsCodeFrom`).
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.evalOutput_seqExactlyOneAll`: exact evaluation correctness.
+* `Cslib.Circuits.Boolean.card_evalOutput_eq_modelCountOn_tseitinSatCNF`: exact model-count
+  preservation of any well-formed De Morgan gate list compiled via `tseitinSatCNF [] n gates o`.
+-/
+
+public section
+
+namespace Cslib.Circuits.Boolean
+
+open Cslib.Logic.PL
+
+/-! ### Prefix model-count preservation for `tseitinSatCNF` -/
+
+private theorem eq_evalCode_of_eval_tseitinSatCNF {n : ℕ} {gates : List (Op × List ℕ)} {o : ℕ}
+    (hcode : Program.IsCodeFrom signature n 0 gates) {σ : ℕ → Bool}
+    (hσ : (tseitinSatCNF [] n gates o).eval σ = true) :
+    ∀ w < n + gates.length, σ w =
+      (evalCode interpretation false (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => σ i) gates).getD w false := by
+  have h := (eval_tseitinSatCNF_eq_true_iff [] n gates o σ).mp hσ
+  exact (eval_tseitinCNF_eq_true_iff_evalCode hcode σ).mp h.2.2
+
+/-- Explicit assignment bijection between bit strings accepted by a single-output well-formed
+gate list and satisfying assignments of `tseitinSatCNF [] n gates o` on
+`Finset.range (n + gates.length)`. -/
+def tseitinSatAssignmentEquiv {n : ℕ} {gates : List (Op × List ℕ)} {o : ℕ}
+    (hcode : Program.IsCodeFrom signature n 0 gates) (ho : o < n + gates.length) :
+    {x : Fin n → Bool // evalOutput (List.ofFn x) gates o = true} ≃
+      {σ : Finset.range (n + gates.length) → Bool //
+        (tseitinSatCNF [] n gates o).eval
+          (fun w => if hw : w ∈ Finset.range (n + gates.length) then σ ⟨w, hw⟩ else false) =
+            true} where
+  toFun x :=
+    ⟨fun w => (evalCode interpretation false (List.ofFn x.1) gates).getD w.1 false, by
+      let vals := evalCode interpretation false (List.ofFn x.1) gates
+      let ext : ℕ → Bool := fun w =>
+        if hw : w ∈ Finset.range (n + gates.length) then vals.getD w false else false
+      have hin (i : ℕ) (hi : i < n) : vals.getD i false = x.1 ⟨i, hi⟩ := by
+        obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := prefix_evalCode interpretation false (List.ofFn x.1) gates
+        dsimp [vals]
+        rw [← hr, List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by simp [hi]),
+          List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simpa using hi), List.getElem_ofFn]
+      have hext (w : ℕ) (hw : w < n + gates.length) : ext w = vals.getD w false := by
+        dsimp only [ext]
+        simp only [Finset.mem_range.mpr hw, ↓reduceDIte]
+      have heqFn : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => ext i) = List.ofFn x.1 := by
+        refine List.ext_getElem (by simp) fun i h₁ _ => ?_
+        have hi : i < n := by simpa using h₁
+        rw [List.getElem_ofFn, List.getElem_ofFn,
+          hext i (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Nat.le_add_right _ _)), hin i hi]
+      have hcnf : (tseitinCNF n gates).eval ext = true := by
+        rw [eval_tseitinCNF_eq_true_iff_evalCode hcode ext, heqFn]
+        exact hext
+      rw [eval_tseitinSatCNF_eq_true_iff]
+      refine ⟨?_, fun i hi => by simp at hi, hcnf⟩
+      change ext o = true
+      rw [hext o ho]
+      exact x.2⟩
+  invFun σ :=
+    ⟨fun i => σ.1 ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 (Nat.le_add_right _ _))⟩, by
+      let ext : ℕ → Bool := fun w =>
+        if hw : w ∈ Finset.range (n + gates.length) then σ.1 ⟨w, hw⟩ else false
+      have hval := eq_evalCode_of_eval_tseitinSatCNF hcode σ.2 o ho
+      have ho' := ((eval_tseitinSatCNF_eq_true_iff [] n gates o ext).mp σ.2).1
+      have hof : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
+          σ.1 ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 (Nat.le_add_right _ _))⟩) =
+          List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => ext i := by
+        refine List.ext_getElem (by simp) fun i h₁ _ => ?_
+        have hi : i < n := by simpa using h₁
+        have hmi : i ∈ Finset.range (n + gates.length) :=
+          Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
+        dsimp only [ext]
+        simp only [List.getElem_ofFn, hmi, ↓reduceDIte]
+      rw [hof, evalOutput, ← hval]
+      change ext o = true
+      exact ho'⟩
+  left_inv x := by
+    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := x
+    ext i
+    obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := prefix_evalCode interpretation false (List.ofFn x) gates
+    change (evalCode interpretation false (List.ofFn x) gates).getD i.1 false = x i
+    rw [← hr, List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (by simp [i.2]),
+      List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ (by simp [i.2])]
+    simp
+  right_inv σ := by
+    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := σ
+    ext w
+    change (evalCode interpretation false (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
+      σ ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 (Nat.le_add_right _ _))⟩)
+      gates).getD w.1 false = σ w
+    let ext : ℕ → Bool := fun u =>
+      if hu : u ∈ Finset.range (n + gates.length) then σ ⟨u, hu⟩ else false
+    have hval := eq_evalCode_of_eval_tseitinSatCNF hcode hσ w.1 (Finset.mem_range.mp w.2)
+    have hof : (List.ofFn fun i : Fin n =>
+        σ ⟨i.1, Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le i.2 (Nat.le_add_right _ _))⟩) =
+        List.ofFn fun i : Fin n => ext i := by
+      refine List.ext_getElem (by simp) fun i h₁ _ => ?_
+      have hi : i < n := by simpa using h₁
+      have hmi : i ∈ Finset.range (n + gates.length) :=
+        Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le hi (Nat.le_add_right _ _))
+      dsimp only [ext]
+      simp only [List.getElem_ofFn, hmi, ↓reduceDIte]
+    rw [hof, ← hval]
+    simp only [w.2, ↓reduceDIte]
+
+/-- **`tseitinSatCNF` preserves the exact number of accepting input bitstrings.** -/
+theorem card_evalOutput_eq_modelCountOn_tseitinSatCNF {n : ℕ} {gates : List (Op × List ℕ)} {o : ℕ}
+    (hcode : Program.IsCodeFrom signature n 0 gates) (ho : o < n + gates.length) :
+    (Finset.univ.filter fun x : Fin n → Bool => evalOutput (List.ofFn x) gates o = true).card =
+      (tseitinSatCNF [] n gates o).modelCountOn (Finset.range (n + gates.length)) := by
+  classical
+  rw [CNF.modelCountOn, ← Fintype.card_coe, ← Fintype.card_coe]
+  exact Fintype.card_congr ((Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (by simp)).trans
+    ((tseitinSatAssignmentEquiv hcode ho).trans (Equiv.subtypeEquivRight (by simp))))
+
+/-- Every occurring variable of `tseitinSatCNF [] n gates o` is strictly below `n + gates.length`
+when `gates` is well-formed (`IsCodeFrom signature n 0 gates`) and `o < n + gates.length`. -/
+theorem vars_tseitinSatCNF_subset {n : ℕ} {gates : List (Op × List ℕ)} {o : ℕ}
+    (hcode : Program.IsCodeFrom signature n 0 gates) (ho : o < n + gates.length)
+    (hpos : 0 < n + gates.length) :
+    (tseitinSatCNF [] n gates o).vars.toFinset ⊆ Finset.range (n + gates.length) := by
+  intro v hv
+  rw [List.mem_toFinset, CNF.vars, List.mem_map] at hv
+  obtain ⟨l, hl, rfl⟩ := hv
+  rw [List.mem_flatten] at hl
+  obtain ⟨c, hc, hl⟩ := hl
+  rw [tseitinSatCNF, List.mapIdx_nil, List.mem_append, List.mem_singleton] at hc
+  rcases hc with rfl | hc
+  · simp only [unitClause, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl
+    rcases hl with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> exact Finset.mem_range.mpr ho
+  · simp only [tseitinCNF, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_finRange, true_and, gateClauses,
+      List.mem_ofFn] at hc
+    obtain ⟨g, j, rfl⟩ := hc
+    have hlt := hcode.getElem g g.isLt
+    have harg (idx : ℕ) : gates[g].2.getD idx 0 ∈ Finset.range (n + gates.length) := by
+      by_cases hidx : idx < gates[g].2.length
+      · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_getElem hidx, Option.getD_some]
+        exact Finset.mem_range.mpr ((hlt.2 _ (List.getElem_mem hidx)).trans (by omega))
+      · rw [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_eq_none (by omega), Option.getD_none]
+        exact Finset.mem_range.mpr hpos
+    rcases mem_tseitinClause hl with h1 | h1 | h1
+    · rw [h1]
+      exact Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
+    · rw [h1]
+      exact harg 0
+    · rw [h1]
+      exact harg 1
+
+/-! ### `IsCodeFrom` and single-gate `evalCode` helpers -/
+
+private theorem isCodeFrom_const (n k : ℕ) (v : Bool) (rest : List (Op × List ℕ))
+    (hrest : Program.IsCodeFrom signature n (k + 1) rest) :
+    Program.IsCodeFrom signature n k ((Op.const v, []) :: rest) :=
+  ⟨⟨rfl, fun _ h => by simp at h⟩, hrest⟩
+
+private theorem isCodeFrom_not (n k a : ℕ) (rest : List (Op × List ℕ))
+    (ha : a < n + k) (hrest : Program.IsCodeFrom signature n (k + 1) rest) :
+    Program.IsCodeFrom signature n k ((Op.not, [a]) :: rest) :=
+  ⟨⟨rfl, fun i hi => by simp only [List.mem_singleton] at hi; exact hi ▸ ha⟩, hrest⟩
+
+private theorem isCodeFrom_bin (n k : ℕ) (op : Op) (har : signature.Arity op = 2)
+    (a b : ℕ) (rest : List (Op × List ℕ)) (ha : a < n + k) (hb : b < n + k)
+    (hrest : Program.IsCodeFrom signature n (k + 1) rest) :
+    Program.IsCodeFrom signature n k ((op, [a, b]) :: rest) := by
+  refine ⟨⟨har.symm, fun i hi => ?_⟩, hrest⟩
+  simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hi
+  rcases hi with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
+
+private theorem getD_evalCode_prefix {x : List Bool} {gates rest : List (Op × List ℕ)}
+    {u : ℕ} (hu : u < x.length + gates.length) :
+    (evalCode interpretation false x (gates ++ rest)).getD u false =
+      (evalCode interpretation false x gates).getD u false := by
+  rw [evalCode_append]
+  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := prefix_evalCode interpretation false (evalCode interpretation false x gates)
+    rest
+  have hlen : (evalCode interpretation false x gates).length = x.length + gates.length :=
+    length_evalCode ..
+  rw [← hr, List.getD_append _ _ _ _ (hlen ▸ hu)]
+
+private theorem getD_evalCode_append_const {x : List Bool} {gates : List (Op × List ℕ)}
+    (v : Bool) :
+    (evalCode interpretation false x (gates ++ [(.const v, [])])).getD
+        (x.length + gates.length) false = v := by
+  rw [evalCode_append_singleton]
+  have hlen : (evalCode interpretation false x gates).length = x.length + gates.length :=
+    length_evalCode ..
+  rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega), hlen, Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]
+  rfl
+
+private theorem getD_evalCode_append_not {x : List Bool} {gates : List (Op × List ℕ)} (a : ℕ) :
+    (evalCode interpretation false x (gates ++ [(.not, [a])])).getD
+        (x.length + gates.length) false =
+      !((evalCode interpretation false x gates).getD a false) := by
+  rw [evalCode_append_singleton]
+  have hlen : (evalCode interpretation false x gates).length = x.length + gates.length :=
+    length_evalCode ..
+  rw [List.getD_append_right _ _ _ _ (by omega), hlen, Nat.sub_self, List.getD_cons_zero]

+/-! ### Graph adjacency helper from vertex and edge lists -/

+/-- Edges between distinct declared vertices of `vs`. -/
+@[expose] def edgePairs [DecidableEq V] (vs : List V) (es : List (V × V)) : List (V × V) :=
+  es.filter fun e => decide (e.1 ∈ vs ∧ e.2 ∈ vs ∧ e.1 ≠ e.2)
+
+private theorem mem_edgePairs [DecidableEq V] {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)} {e : V × V} :
+    e ∈ edgePairs vs es ↔ e ∈ es ∧ e.1 ∈ vs ∧ e.2 ∈ vs ∧ e.1 ≠ e.2 := by
+  simp only [edgePairs, List.mem_filter, decide_eq_true_eq]

+/-! ### 1. Independent sets (`n = |V|`, width `2`) -/
+
+/-- **CNF encoding of independent sets**: one variable per vertex `v ∈ vs`, tautology
+`[(v, true), (v, false)]` so all declared vertices occur, and `[(e.1, false), (e.2, false)]` for
+every declared edge `e ∈ es`. Every clause has width `2`. -/
+@[expose] def indepSetCNF [DecidableEq V] (vs : List V) (es : List (V × V)) : CNF V :=
+  (vs.map fun v => [(v, true), (v, false)]) ++
+    ((edgePairs vs es).map fun e => [(e.1, false), (e.2, false)])
+
+/-- Every clause of `indepSetCNF vs es` has length `2`. -/
+theorem length_clause_indepSetCNF [DecidableEq V] {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)} {c : Clause V}
+    (hc : c ∈ indepSetCNF vs es) : c.length = 2 := by
+  simp only [indepSetCNF, List.mem_append, List.mem_map] at hc
+  rcases hc with ⟨v, _, rfl⟩ | ⟨e, _, rfl⟩ <;> rfl
+
+/-- The occurring variables of `indepSetCNF vs es` are precisely the vertices in `vs`. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem mem_vars_indepSetCNF [DecidableEq V] {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)} {v : V} :
+    v ∈ (indepSetCNF vs es).vars ↔ v ∈ vs := by
+  simp only [indepSetCNF, CNF.vars, List.flatten_append, List.map_append, List.mem_append,
+    List.mem_map, List.mem_flatten]
+  constructor
+  · rintro (⟨l, ⟨c, ⟨u, hu, rfl⟩, hl⟩, rfl⟩ | ⟨l, ⟨c, ⟨e, he, rfl⟩, hl⟩, rfl⟩)
+    · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl
+      rcases hl with rfl | rfl <;> exact hu
+    · simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl
+      obtain ⟨-, h1, h2, -⟩ := mem_edgePairs.mp he
+      rcases hl with rfl | rfl <;> assumption
+  · intro hv
+    exact Or.inl ⟨(v, true), ⟨[(v, true), (v, false)], ⟨v, hv, rfl⟩, List.mem_cons_self ..⟩, rfl⟩
+
+/-- `indepSetCNF vs es` has at most `vs.toFinset.card` variables (equality holds always). -/
+@[simp]
+theorem numVars_indepSetCNF [DecidableEq V] (vs : List V) (es : List (V × V)) :
+    (indepSetCNF vs es).numVars = vs.toFinset.card := by
+  unfold CNF.numVars
+  congr 1
+  ext v
+  simp only [List.mem_toFinset, mem_vars_indepSetCNF]
+
+/-- Evaluation of `indepSetCNF vs es` under `σ`: no declared edge has both endpoints `true`. -/
+theorem eval_indepSetCNF [DecidableEq V] (vs : List V) (es : List (V × V)) (σ : V → Bool) :
+    (indepSetCNF vs es).eval σ = true ↔
+      ∀ e ∈ es, e.1 ∈ vs → e.2 ∈ vs → e.1 ≠ e.2 → σ e.1 = true → σ e.2 = true → False := by
+  simp only [indepSetCNF, CNF.eval_append, Bool.and_eq_true, CNF.eval_eq_true_iff,
+    List.forall_mem_map, mem_edgePairs]
+  have htaut : ∀ v ∈ vs, Clause.eval σ [(v, true), (v, false)] = true := fun v _ => by
+    simp [Clause.eval, Literal.eval]
+  rw [iff_true_intro htaut, true_and]
+  simp only [Clause.eval_eq_true_iff, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false,
+    exists_eq_or_imp, exists_eq_left, Bool.eq_false_iff, ne_eq]
+  constructor
+  · intro h e he h1 h2 hne hs1 hs2
+    rcases h e ⟨he, h1, h2, hne⟩ with h' | h'
+    · exact h' hs1
+    · exact h' hs2
+  · intro h e ⟨he, h1, h2, hne⟩
+    by_cases hs1 : σ e.1 = true
+    · exact Or.inr fun hs2 => h e he h1 h2 hne hs1 hs2
+    · exact Or.inl hs1
+
+/-- **Assignment bijection for `indepSetCNF`**: given a simple graph `G` on vertex subtype
+`{v // v ∈ vs}` whose adjacency matches `es`, satisfying assignments on `vs.toFinset` biject with
+independent sets of `G`. -/
+def indepSetCNFEquiv [DecidableEq V] {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)}
+    {G : SimpleGraph {v : V // v ∈ vs}}

+      u.1 ≠ w.1 ∧ ((u.1, w.1) ∈ es ∨ (w.1, u.1) ∈ es)) :
+    {σ : vs.toFinset → Bool //
+      (indepSetCNF vs es).eval (fun v => if hv : v ∈ vs.toFinset then σ ⟨v, hv⟩ else false) =

+      {S : Finset {v : V // v ∈ vs} // G.IsIndepSet (S : Set {v : V // v ∈ vs})} where
+  toFun σ :=
+    ⟨Finset.univ.filter fun u => σ.1 ⟨u.1, List.mem_toFinset.mpr u.2⟩ = true, by
+      intro u hu w hw hne hadj
+      rw [Finset.coe_filter, Set.mem_ofPred_eq] at hu hw
+      obtain ⟨-, h1 | h2⟩ := (hG u w).mp hadj
+      · exact ((eval_indepSetCNF vs es _).mp σ.2 (u.1, w.1) h1 u.2 w.2
+          (fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h)))
+          (by simpa [List.mem_toFinset.mpr u.2] using hu.2)
+          (by simpa [List.mem_toFinset.mpr w.2] using hw.2)
+      · exact ((eval_indepSetCNF vs es _).mp σ.2 (w.1, u.1) h2 w.2 u.2
+          (fun h => hne (Subtype.ext h.symm)))
+          (by simpa [List.mem_toFinset.mpr w.2] using hw.2)
+          (by simpa [List.mem_toFinset.mpr u.2] using hu.2)⟩
+  invFun S :=
+    ⟨fun v => decide (⟨v.1, List.mem_toFinset.mp v.2⟩ ∈ S.1), by
+      rw [eval_indepSetCNF]
+      intro e he h1 h2 hne hs1 hs2
+      have hm1 : e.1 ∈ vs.toFinset := List.mem_toFinset.mpr h1
+      have hm2 : e.2 ∈ vs.toFinset := List.mem_toFinset.mpr h2
+      simp only [hm1, ↓reduceDIte, decide_eq_true_eq] at hs1
+      simp only [hm2, ↓reduceDIte, decide_eq_true_eq] at hs2
+      have hadj : G.Adj ⟨e.1, h1⟩ ⟨e.2, h2⟩ := (hG _ _).mpr ⟨hne, Or.inl he⟩
+      exact S.2 hs1 hs2 (fun h => hne (congrArg Subtype.val h)) hadj⟩
+  left_inv σ := by
+    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := σ
+    ext v
+    have hmv := List.mem_toFinset.mp v.2
+    simp
+  right_inv S := by
+    obtain ⟨S, hS⟩ := S
+    ext v
+    simp
+
+/-- **`indepSetCNF` preserves the exact count of independent sets.** -/
+theorem modelCount_indepSetCNF [DecidableEq V] {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)}
+    {G : SimpleGraph {v : V // v ∈ vs}}
+    (hG : ∀ (u w : {v : V // v ∈ vs}), G.Adj u w ↔
+      u.1 ≠ w.1 ∧ ((u.1, w.1) ∈ es ∨ (w.1, u.1) ∈ es)) :
+    (indepSetCNF vs es).modelCount =
+      Nat.card {S : Finset {v : V // v ∈ vs} // G.IsIndepSet (S : Set {v : V // v ∈ vs})} := by
+  classical
+  have hvars : (indepSetCNF vs es).vars.toFinset = vs.toFinset := by
+    ext v; simp
+  rw [← modelCountOn_vars, hvars, modelCountOn, ← Nat.card_eq_finsetCard]
+  exact Nat.card_congr ((Equiv.subtypeEquivRight
+    (fun _ => by simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and])).trans
+    (indepSetCNFEquiv hG))
+
+/-! ### 2. Proper `q`-colourings (`n = q * |V|`, width `≤ max q 2`) -/
+
+/-- **CNF encoding of proper `q`-colourings**: one-hot variables `(v, c)` (`c < q`) per vertex
+`v ∈ vs`, `CNF.exactlyOne` constraints for every vertex, and edge exclusions
+`[((e.1, c), false), ((e.2, c), false)]` for every declared edge `e` and colour `c < q`. -/
+@[expose] def coloringCNF [DecidableEq V] (q : ℕ) (vs : List V) (es : List (V × V)) : CNF (V × ℕ) :=
+  (vs.flatMap fun v => CNF.exactlyOne ((List.range q).map fun c => (v, c))) ++
+    ((edgePairs vs es).flatMap fun e =>
+      (List.range q).map fun c => [((e.1, c), false), ((e.2, c), false)])
+
+/-- Every clause of `coloringCNF q vs es` has width at most `max q 2`. -/
+theorem length_clause_coloringCNF_le [DecidableEq V] {q : ℕ} {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)}
+    {c : Clause (V × ℕ)} (hc : c ∈ coloringCNF q vs es) : c.length ≤ max q 2 := by
+  simp only [coloringCNF, List.mem_append, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at hc
+  rcases hc with ⟨v, _, hc⟩ | ⟨e, _, col, _, rfl⟩
+  · rw [CNF.exactlyOne, List.mem_append] at hc
+    rcases hc with hc | hc
+    · rw [CNF.atLeastOne, List.mem_singleton] at hc
+      subst hc
+      simp
+    · simp only [CNF.atMostOne, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map] at hc
+      obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, rfl⟩ := hc
+      exact le_max_right q 2
+  · exact le_max_right q 2
+
+/-- The occurring variables of `coloringCNF q vs es` are `{v ∈ vs} × {c < q}`. -/
+@[simp]
+theorem mem_vars_coloringCNF [DecidableEq V] {q : ℕ} {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)}
+    {p : V × ℕ} :
+    p ∈ (coloringCNF q vs es).vars ↔ p.1 ∈ vs ∧ p.2 < q := by
+  cases p with
+  | mk v col =>
+    simp only [coloringCNF, CNF.vars, List.flatten_append, List.map_append, List.mem_append,
+      List.mem_map, List.mem_flatten, List.mem_flatMap]
+    constructor
+    · rintro (⟨⟨p', b⟩, ⟨c, ⟨w, hw, hc⟩, hl⟩, heq⟩ |
+          ⟨⟨p', b⟩, ⟨c, ⟨e, he, col', hcol', rfl⟩, hl⟩, heq⟩)
+      · have heqp' : p' = (v, col) := heq
+        subst heqp'
+        have hmem := CNF.fst_mem_of_mem_exactlyOne hc hl
+        rw [List.mem_map] at hmem
+        obtain ⟨k, hk, heqp⟩ := hmem
+        rw [List.mem_range] at hk
+        cases heqp
+        exact ⟨hw, hk⟩
+      · have heqp' : p' = (v, col) := heq
+        subst heqp'
+        obtain ⟨-, h1, h2, -⟩ := mem_edgePairs.mp he
+        rw [List.mem_range] at hcol'
+        simp only [List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false] at hl
+        rcases hl with hl1 | hl2
+        · cases hl1; exact ⟨h1, hcol'⟩
+        · cases hl2; exact ⟨h2, hcol'⟩
+    · rintro ⟨hv, hcol⟩
+      refine Or.inl ⟨((v, col), true),
+        ⟨((List.range q).map fun c => (v, c)).map (·, true), ?_, ?_⟩, rfl⟩
+      · refine ⟨v, hv, ?_⟩
+        rw [CNF.exactlyOne, List.mem_append]
+        exact Or.inl (by simp [CNF.atLeastOne])
+      · exact List.mem_map.mpr ⟨(v, col), List.mem_map.mpr ⟨col, List.mem_range.mpr hcol, rfl⟩, rfl⟩
+
+/-- `coloringCNF q vs es` has `q * |vs.toFinset|` occurring variables. -/
+theorem numVars_coloringCNF [DecidableEq V] (q : ℕ) (vs : List V) (es : List (V × V)) :
+    (coloringCNF q vs es).numVars = vs.toFinset.card * q := by
+  have hvars : (coloringCNF q vs es).vars.toFinset = vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q := by
+    ext ⟨v, c⟩
+    simp only [List.mem_toFinset, mem_vars_coloringCNF, Finset.mem_product, Finset.mem_range]
+  rw [CNF.numVars, hvars, Finset.card_product, Finset.card_range]
+
+/-- Evaluation of `coloringCNF q vs es` under `σ`: every `v ∈ vs` has a unique true colour `< q`,
+and adjacent vertices never share a colour. -/
+theorem eval_coloringCNF [DecidableEq V] (q : ℕ) (vs : List V) (es : List (V × V))
+    (σ : V × ℕ → Bool) :
+    (coloringCNF q vs es).eval σ = true ↔
+      (∀ v ∈ vs, (∃ c < q, σ (v, c) = true) ∧
+        ∀ c₁ < q, ∀ c₂ < q, σ (v, c₁) = true → σ (v, c₂) = true → c₁ = c₂) ∧
+      (∀ e ∈ es, e.1 ∈ vs → e.2 ∈ vs → e.1 ≠ e.2 →
+        ∀ c < q, σ (e.1, c) = true → σ (e.2, c) = true → False) := by
+  rw [coloringCNF, CNF.eval_append, Bool.and_eq_true, CNF.eval_flatMap_eq_true_iff,
+    CNF.eval_flatMap_eq_true_iff]
+  refine and_congr ?_ ?_
+  · refine forall₂_congr fun v _ => ?_
+    rw [CNF.eval_exactlyOne]
+    simp only [List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
+    constructor
+    · rintro ⟨⟨_, ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, hsc⟩, huniq⟩
+      refine ⟨⟨c, hc, hsc⟩, fun c₁ hc₁ c₂ hc₂ h1 h2 => ?_⟩
+      have heq := huniq (v, c₁) ⟨c₁, hc₁, rfl⟩ (v, c₂) ⟨c₂, hc₂, rfl⟩ h1 h2
+      exact congrArg Prod.snd heq
+    · rintro ⟨⟨c, hc, hsc⟩, huniq⟩
+      refine ⟨⟨(v, c), ⟨c, hc, rfl⟩, hsc⟩, ?_⟩
+      rintro ⟨v₁, c₁⟩ ⟨k₁, hk₁, heq₁⟩ ⟨v₂, c₂⟩ ⟨k₂, hk₂, heq₂⟩ h1 h2
+      cases heq₁; cases heq₂
+      exact congrArg (v, ·) (huniq c₁ hk₁ c₂ hk₂ h1 h2)
+  · simp only [mem_edgePairs, CNF.eval_eq_true_iff, List.forall_mem_map, List.mem_range,
+      Clause.eval_eq_true_iff, List.mem_cons, List.not_mem_nil, or_false, exists_eq_or_imp,
+      exists_eq_left, Bool.eq_false_iff]
+    constructor
+    · intro h e he h1 h2 hne c hc hs1 hs2
+      rcases h e ⟨he, h1, h2, hne⟩ c hc with h' | h'
+      · exact h' hs1
+      · exact h' hs2
+    · intro h e ⟨he, h1, h2, hne⟩ c hc
+      by_cases hs1 : σ (e.1, c) = true
+      · exact Or.inr fun hs2 => h e he h1 h2 hne c hc hs1 hs2
+      · exact Or.inl hs1
+
+private noncomputable def coloringDecode [DecidableEq V] {q : ℕ} {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)}
+    {σ : (vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q : Finset (V × ℕ)) → Bool}
+    (hσ : (coloringCNF q vs es).eval
+      (fun p => if hp : p ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q then σ ⟨p, hp⟩ else false) = true)
+    (u : {v : V // v ∈ vs}) : Fin q :=
+  let h := ((eval_coloringCNF q vs es _).mp hσ).1 u.1 u.2
+  ⟨h.1.choose, h.1.choose_spec.1⟩
+
+private theorem coloringDecode_spec [DecidableEq V] {q : ℕ} {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)}
+    {σ : (vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q : Finset (V × ℕ)) → Bool}
+    (hσ : (coloringCNF q vs es).eval
+      (fun p => if hp : p ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q then σ ⟨p, hp⟩ else false) = true)
+    (u : {v : V // v ∈ vs}) :
+    (if hp : (u.1, (coloringDecode hσ u).1) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q
+      then σ ⟨(u.1, (coloringDecode hσ u).1), hp⟩ else false) = true :=
+  (((eval_coloringCNF q vs es _).mp hσ).1 u.1 u.2).1.choose_spec.2
+
+/-- **Assignment bijection for `coloringCNF`**: satisfying assignments on the one-hot variables
+`vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q` biject with proper `Fin q`-colourings of `G`. -/
+noncomputable def coloringCNFEquiv [DecidableEq V] {q : ℕ} {vs : List V} {es : List (V × V)}
+    {G : SimpleGraph {v : V // v ∈ vs}}
+    (hG : ∀ (u w : {v : V // v ∈ vs}), G.Adj u w ↔
+      u.1 ≠ w.1 ∧ ((u.1, w.1) ∈ es ∨ (w.1, u.1) ∈ es)) :
+    {σ : (vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q : Finset (V × ℕ)) → Bool //
+      (coloringCNF q vs es).eval
+        (fun p => if hp : p ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q then σ ⟨p, hp⟩ else false) =
+          true} ≃
+      G.Coloring (Fin q) where
+  toFun σ :=
+    SimpleGraph.Coloring.mk (coloringDecode σ.2) fun {u w} hadj hfin => by
+      have heqcol : (coloringDecode σ.2 u).1 = (coloringDecode σ.2 w).1 := congrArg Fin.val hfin
+      obtain ⟨hne, h1 | h2⟩ := (hG u w).mp hadj
+      · exact ((eval_coloringCNF q vs es _).mp σ.2).2 (u.1, w.1) h1 u.2 w.2
+          (fun h => hne h) (coloringDecode σ.2 u).1 (coloringDecode σ.2 u).2
+          (coloringDecode_spec σ.2 u) (heqcol ▸ coloringDecode_spec σ.2 w)
+      · exact ((eval_coloringCNF q vs es _).mp σ.2).2 (w.1, u.1) h2 w.2 u.2
+          (fun h => hne h.symm) (coloringDecode σ.2 u).1 (coloringDecode σ.2 u).2
+          (heqcol ▸ coloringDecode_spec σ.2 w) (coloringDecode_spec σ.2 u)
+  invFun C :=
+    ⟨fun p => decide (p.1.2 = (C ⟨p.1.1, List.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp p.2).1⟩).1), by
+      rw [eval_coloringCNF]
+      refine ⟨fun v hv => ?_, fun e he h1 h2 hne c hc hs1 hs2 => ?_⟩
+      · refine ⟨⟨(C ⟨v, hv⟩).1, (C ⟨v, hv⟩).2, ?_⟩, fun c₁ hc₁ c₂ hc₂ h1 h2 => ?_⟩
+        · have hp : (v, (C ⟨v, hv⟩).1) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q :=
+            Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, Finset.mem_range.mpr (C ⟨v, hv⟩).2⟩
+          simp [hp]
+        · have hp1 : (v, c₁) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q :=
+            Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, Finset.mem_range.mpr hc₁⟩
+          have hp2 : (v, c₂) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q :=
+            Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, Finset.mem_range.mpr hc₂⟩
+          simp only [hp1, ↓reduceDIte, decide_eq_true_eq] at h1
+          simp only [hp2, ↓reduceDIte, decide_eq_true_eq] at h2
+          exact h1.trans h2.symm
+      · have hp1 : (e.1, c) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q :=
+          Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr h1, Finset.mem_range.mpr hc⟩
+        have hp2 : (e.2, c) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q :=
+          Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr h2, Finset.mem_range.mpr hc⟩
+        simp only [hp1, ↓reduceDIte, decide_eq_true_eq] at hs1
+        simp only [hp2, ↓reduceDIte, decide_eq_true_eq] at hs2
+        have hadj : G.Adj ⟨e.1, h1⟩ ⟨e.2, h2⟩ := (hG _ _).mpr ⟨hne, Or.inl he⟩
+        exact C.valid hadj (Fin.ext (hs1.symm.trans hs2))⟩
+  left_inv σ := by
+    obtain ⟨σ, hσ⟩ := σ
+    ext ⟨⟨v, c⟩, hp⟩
+    have hv : v ∈ vs := List.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).1
+    have hc : c < q := Finset.mem_range.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp hp).2
+    have huniq := ((eval_coloringCNF q vs es _).mp hσ).1 v hv
+    let col : ℕ := (coloringDecode hσ ⟨v, hv⟩).1
+    have hcolLt : col < q := (coloringDecode hσ ⟨v, hv⟩).2
+    have hpcol : (v, col) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q :=
+      Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨List.mem_toFinset.mpr hv, Finset.mem_range.mpr hcolLt⟩
+    have hσcol : σ ⟨(v, col), hpcol⟩ = true := by
+      have hspec := coloringDecode_spec hσ ⟨v, hv⟩
+      change (if h : (v, col) ∈ vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q
+        then σ ⟨(v, col), h⟩ else false) = true at hspec
+      simpa only [hpcol, ↓reduceDIte] using hspec
+    change decide (c = col) = σ ⟨(v, c), hp⟩
+    by_cases hval : σ ⟨(v, c), hp⟩ = true
+    · have hc_eq : c = col := huniq.2 c hc col hcolLt (by simpa [hp] using hval)
+        (by simpa [hpcol] using hσcol)
+      subst hc_eq
+      simp [hval]
+    · have hne : c ≠ col := by
+        rintro rfl
+        exact hval hσcol
+      have hfalse : σ ⟨(v, c), hp⟩ = false := Bool.eq_false_iff.mpr hval
+      simp [hfalse, hne]
+  right_inv C := by
+    ext ⟨u, hu⟩
+    dsimp only
+    let σ0 : (vs.toFinset ×ˢ Finset.range q : Finset (V × ℕ)) → Bool := fun p =>
+      decide (p.1.2 = (C ⟨p.1.1, List.mem_toFinset.mp (Finset.mem_product.mp p.2).1⟩).1)
+    have hσ0 : (coloringCNF q vs es).eval
body: [P2] Share the coloring-to-assignment correctness proof. `hσ0` repeats the entire one-hot existence/uniqueness and edge-validity argument already used by `invFun` at lines 330–351, for exactly the same assignment. Extract the encoding and its evaluation lemma (private is sufficient if there is no external client), then use it in both `invFun` and `right_inv`. This removes a substantial duplicate proof from this new equivalence and gives its two halves one contract to maintain.
